name: 19383 · West Chester, PA
findings: ZIP 19383 (West Chester) has 12 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19383 (West Chester) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
